recommendations.title: 3 of 12 machines in W11-Dedicated-Engineering differ from the rest of the catalog

recommendations.title: 1 group cycle(s) found in the directory
recommendations.action: Break the cycle. Circular nesting is legal in Active Directory but hides who is really a member.

recommendations.title: 11 user(s) can use both W11-Pooled-Finance and W11-Pooled-General, which share 80% of their software
recommendations.action: Check whether these users need both desktops. Only in W11-Pooled-Finance: Microsoft Power BI Desktop, SAP GUI for Windows. Only in W11-Pooled-General: nothing.

recommendations.title: 11 user(s) can use both W11-Pooled-Finance and WS2022-Shared-Desktop, which share 80% of their software
recommendations.action: Check whether these users need both desktops. Only in W11-Pooled-Finance: Microsoft Power BI Desktop, SAP GUI for Windows. Only in WS2022-Shared-Desktop: nothing.

recommendations.title: 42 user(s) can use both W11-Pooled-General and WS2022-Shared-Desktop, which share 100% of their software
recommendations.action: Check whether these users need both desktops. Only in W11-Pooled-General: nothing. Only in WS2022-Shared-Desktop: nothing.

recommendations.title: W10-Legacy-Apps is not used by any delivery group
recommendations.action: These machines consume resources and licenses but no user can reach them. Add them to a delivery group or remove them.

recommendations.title: W11-Pooled-Pilot has no machines
recommendations.action: Delete the catalog if it is no longer planned, or record its purpose.

recommendations.title: 3 private desktop(s) have not been used for 60 days or more
recommendations.action: Confirm with the owners and reclaim the machines and their licenses.

recommendations.title: 5 user(s) reach a desktop through more than 3 levels of nested groups
recommendations.action: Deep nesting makes access reviews hard to follow. Entitle a flatter group closer to the users.

recommendations.title: 2 user(s) are granted a desktop but blocked by the access policy
recommendations.action: Usually intended (for example contractors excluded from a group). Confirm, or remove them from the desktop rule so the two rules agree.

recommendations.title: Legacy Desktops (retired) is disabled but still entitles 2 user(s)
recommendations.action: Remove the delivery group, or its rules, once the retirement is confirmed.
